name: XIAO ESP32-C5
note: Existing guard target. Radio/network components excluded from the build. Hardware acceptance pending.

name: XIAO ESP32-C6
note: ESP-IDF port with two remapped UARTs and native USB. Hardware acceptance pending.

name: XIAO ESP32-S3 (base board)
note: Base board profile. Remove Sense expansion hardware: its SD interface shares guard pins. Plus variants are not qualified. Hardware acceptance pending.

name: XIAO RP2350
note: Promising next port: no radio hardware; Seeed exposes two UARTs (UART1 on rear D12 TX / D11 RX). Needs Pico SDK/USB port, provisioning and reset/pin review. No firmware here yet.

name: XIAO RP2040
note: No radio hardware. Base board exposes one default UART; a second link needs a pin-mux/PIO design and timing validation. Needs SDK/USB port. No firmware here yet.

name: XIAO ESP32-C3
note: Two UARTs exist, but this harness cannot be reused: D9 is BOOT, D6/D7 are ROM UART, D2–D5 expose external JTAG. Requires a separate debug/boot containment design before support.
